```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Issue Triage
        id: claude_triage
        uses: anthropic-ai/cclaude-action@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          model: claude-3-sonnet-20240229
          system-prompt: |
            You are an expert issue classifier for the OB1 project. Your job is to:
            1. Classify the issue type (bug, feature request, recipe idea, schema idea, documentation, question, etc.)
            2. Check if this is a duplicate of an existing issue
            3. Assess if the issue fits within OB1's scope
            4. Suggest appropriate labels
            5. Post a welcoming comment to the issue
            Always respond in a structured format with clear sections.
          user-prompt: |
            Please triage this new issue:
            
            Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
            Body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
            Labels: ${{ join(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, ', ') }}
            
            Please provide:
            1. Issue classification
            2. Duplicate check
            3. Scope assessment
            4. Label suggestions
            5. A welcoming comment
            
            Remember: This is for the OB1 project, which focuses on building tools for the open source community.
          max-tokens: 1000

      - name: Add labels based on classification
        if: steps.claude_triage.outputs.classification != ''
        run: |
          gh issue edit ${{ github.event.issue.number }} \
            --add-label "${{ steps.claude_triage.outputs.classification }}" \
            --add-label "triaged"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post welcoming comment
        if: steps.claude_triage.outputs.welcoming_comment != ''
        run: |
          gh issue comment ${{ github.event.issue.number }} \
            --body "${{ steps.claude_triage.outputs.welcoming_comment }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check for duplicates
        if: steps.claude_triage.outputs.duplicate_check != ''
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ steps.claude_triage.outputs.duplicate_check }}" == *"duplicate"* ]]; then
            gh issue comment ${{ github.event.issue.number }} \
              --body "${{ steps.claude_triage.outputs.duplicate_check }}"
            gh issue close ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
